rationale: Identity verification was correctly performed using full name and zip, and the agent sought explicit confirmation before attempting order changes. However, the agent failed to complete the user’s primary request: partially cancel the office items from a pending order. The modify tool calls errored, and the agent concluded item reduction wasn’t possible without offering a human handoff (as required when tools don’t permit the needed action). The agent also did not provide the total refund amount the user requested, even though the line-item prices were available. Additionally, when the user opted to keep the order and update the default address to the Seattle address shown on the order, the agent asked the user to supply the address instead of proposing the known Seattle address from the order and requesting confirmation, resulting in no update. The agent prematurely stated a refund would be sent to the original payment method before the change succeeded. Overall, the user’s requests were not completed in line with policy.
